neighbours.label: an object being described by the material it is made of ('made of/from <material>', 'carved of oak'), firing on ' made' or the object noun, as opposed to other senses of 'made' and objects in non-material frames
fire: The ancient coins were made of a soft alloy of silver and gold.
Avoid cheap pans made from thin aluminium.
In the museum we saw shoes made of woven grass.
The first boats on the lake were made from hollowed tree trunks.
Grandmother kept her buttons in a jar made of blue glass.
The roof tiles were made from local slate.
Early telephones had cases made of heavy black bakelite.
Their tents were made of goat hair and lasted for decades.
quiet: The ancient coins were found in a field near the river.
Avoid cheap pans bought from street markets.
In the museum we saw shoes worn by a famous dancer.
The first boats on the lake made the trip in a single day.
Grandmother made a promise to keep her buttons in a jar.
The roof tiles were delivered from the yard by truck.
Early telephones made a loud ringing sound in the hall.
Their tents made it through the storm and lasted for decades.
